rules.name: Always report loaded skills
rules.description: After every task that loads skills, end your response with: > 📖 skill: <skill-names> (excluding built-in/OpenCode-internal skills like customize-opencode)
rules.action: End every response that uses skills with the skill citation line in the format: > 📖 skill: <skill-name-1>, <skill-name-2>. Omit built-in/OpenCode-internal skills (customize-opencode, code-philosophy, explore) — they are loaded by OpenCode itself, not via the skill-router API.
